summary: Ad-hoc usage CSV export truncated for intervals spanning retention compaction window
description: Customer reports that ad-hoc CSV export of usage events is missing rows when the requested time range overlaps the daily retention compaction window. Export appears truncated at the end boundary of the selected range instead of returning the full set of events. This started after a retention compaction change rolled out last week.
impact: Parcelly is unable to reconcile hourly billing and product analytics for the morning window; missing rows affect invoicing and downstream reconciliations. Currently blocking one customer-facing billing run for yesterday's data.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Login to Console as Org admin for Parcelly. 2) Open Usage -> Exports -> Ad-hoc CSV. 3) Select start: 2026-03-09T01:30:00Z end: 2026-03-09T02:30:00Z (window overlaps compaction at ~02:15 UTC). 4) Submit export and download CSV when ready. 5) Observe final rows stop near 02:14 and total rows count lower than raw event count in trace. Repeat with range not overlapping compaction -> export contains all rows.
observed_behavior: CSV file finishes at event timestamp 2026-03-09T02:14:58Z, later events in raw event store exist up to 02:29:58Z but are absent from export. Export job exits with success code and no error in UI.
expected_behavior: Ad-hoc CSV export should include all events in the inclusive time range requested by the user, regardless of retention compaction schedule. Export job should operate against data snapshot consistent for the requested interval.
logs_snippet:
2026-03-09T02:15:12Z [retention-compactor] compaction job started shard=17
2026-03-09T02:15:13Z [export-worker] export job id=exp_7b3a9 started query end_time=2026-03-09T02:30:00Z
2026-03-09T02:15:14Z [retention-compactor] replacing raw_events shard=17 with rollup buckets up to 02:15:00Z
2026-03-09T02:16:01Z [export-worker] export job id=exp_7b3a9 completed status=success rows=984
2026-03-09T02:17:02Z [query-service] raw query returned rows=1248 for same range
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: race between export query and compaction job leads to inconsistent snapshot. Export queries the raw event table and expects inclusive end_time, but compaction replaces raw rows with pre-aggregated rollups that are excluded by the export query path. Reproduced on staging by scheduling compaction at the same minute as an export request: export completed successfully but returned fewer rows. Query plan shows exporter route prefers optimized rollup table only when compaction marker exists. Possible root cause: compaction sets compaction_marker for shard before rollup write completes, causing exporter to route away from rollup data for timestamps >= marker. Engineering reproducer created and PR drafted to add a short-lived snapshot lock and to adjust exporter routing logic to consult compaction transaction boundaries.
comments: 2026-03-10 - Support (Aisha Patel): Acknowledged ticket and requested CSV and export job id from customer. Asked Parcelly for exact export time and sample missing request ids.
2026-03-10 - Customer (Parcelly - Rajiv Menon): Provided export id exp_7b3a9 and sample missing request ids [r-45231, r-45232]. Confirmed they ran export at ~02:15 UTC.

2026-03-11 - Eng (Liam Chen): Reproduced locally using compaction schedule; validated exporter returned truncated rows when compaction started within 5s of query. Created reproducer script and linked PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1284.

2026-03-12 - Eng (SRE - Maria Gomez): Verified that compaction job writes rollup then flips compaction marker but ordering race can occur on high-throughput shards. Suggested quick mitigation to delay compaction marker flip until fsync of rollup completes. Running canary fix in staging.
2026-03-12 - Support (Aisha Patel): Notified customer of engineering investigation and ETA for fix canary and planned hotfix if canary succeeds.
workaround: Schedule exports to avoid the 02:10-02:20 UTC compaction window as a temporary workaround. For immediate reconciliation, run the raw event query directly against the raw event store via support-assisted job (we ran one-off reconciler and provided CSV to Parcelly).
resolution_notes: Engineering merged hotfix that adds transactional boundary check and delays compaction marker flip until rollup commit confirmation (merged PR 1284). Hotfix deployed to prod us-east on 2026-03-12 18:30 UTC. Verified by running exports that previously failed; exports now return full row counts. Post-deploy smoke validated with Parcelly export ids and reconciled billing batch.
follow_up_actions: Add automated regression test for export vs compaction race
Add metric and alert for export/row-count delta > 1% for dedicated customers
Update retention runbook to include safe compaction window and deployment notes
